data.title: Water’s Edge
data.about:
A waterfront community running alongside its very own promenade and canal, Water’s Edge offers a unique lifestyle on Yas Island – Abu Dhabi’s most exciting destination. 

The fully serviced community is comprised of studio,1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments that enjoy stunning full or partial views over the water from private balconies.
